row.notes: Allocates a shape from the pool at world+0x48, copies the common shape settings from desc (+0x10 float, +0x20..+0x5c transform, flags and floats at +0x60..+0x90) into Ne_PhysShape_InitConvexDefaults with type 4, sets vtable 0x145a5c5f0, radius desc[0] at +0x180 and half height desc[1] at +0x184. Precomputes volume with r' = radius + margin (+0xcc): sphere 4/3*pi*r'^3 plus cylinder 2*h*pi*r'^2 at +0x188 and the two fractions at +0x18c/+0x190; sets flag bit 3 of +0x170 when radius < 0.1 and half height < 2. Returns the handle object placed after the shape (vtable 0x145a5c420, user data from desc+0x98), or null on alloc failure (0xc).
